title: AIPDABE
name: AIPDABE
blurb: AI-assisted Bitcoin block exploration and analysis engine integrating blockchain parsing, transaction inspection, mempool intelligence, UTXO-flow visualization, and human-readable summaries.
description: AIPDABE is a Bitcoin research workbench for transactions, blocks, addresses, mempool state, UTXO flows, and structured analytic summaries. The browser edition uses public Esplora-compatible APIs, optional read-only RPC proxy integration, Canvas visualization, local deterministic analysis, and JSON import/export.
author: [0xdeadbeef] of ZZX-Labs R&D

capabilities.name: Block lookup by height
capabilities.notes: Height-to-hash resolution followed by block lookup.

capabilities.name: Mempool snapshot
capabilities.notes: Transaction count, virtual size, and aggregate fees.

capabilities.name: UTXO-flow visualization
capabilities.notes: Canvas graph of inputs, transaction, and outputs.

capabilities.name: Assistant questions
capabilities.notes: Local context-aware answers for loaded Bitcoin objects.

capabilities.name: External assistant provider
capabilities.notes: Register a custom provider function through the public JavaScript API.

capabilities.name: Bitcoin Core RPC
capabilities.notes: Supported through a separately deployed read-only server-side proxy; credentials are not stored in browser code.

capabilities.name: Workspace export
capabilities.notes: JSON export of current analysis state.
